title: Chapter 157 Clearing The Ancient Battlefield Area 27
content:
Chapter 157 Clearing The Ancient Battlefield Area 27

Wang Shuo was surprised. He wanted to use the "Thought Stamp" scroll, but he didn't know whether it would be useful to the Zerg.

"How to sign it?"

Mira then muttered something, and at this time, a complex circle of light rippled around her.

In the light circle, various runes flickered.

Wang Shuo had never seen this scene before, and he felt a little uneasy.

"Agui, have you seen this kind of contract?"

"My Lord, I haven't seen it."

"Useless thing."

"Master, you can step into the light circle, and our contract will be completed." Mira's pure voice seemed full of temptation.

Wang Shuo raised a wicked smile at the corner of his mouth, but did not step in directly.

He thought that if Da Huang recognized him as his master and became his pet, it would not be so troublesome!

Is this a trap set by the other party?

To be on the safe side, Wang Shuo decided to do it his own way.

"Mira, you agree first and join my territory!" Wang Shuo smiled faintly.

At this time, a prompt sounded in Mira's mind:

[Wang Shuo invites you to join Wana Village, do you agree? 】

Mira had no choice but to agree.

Wang Shuo quickly checked her loyalty, and sure enough, it was only 55 points.

This is a dangerous value, which means that the other party may betray at any time.

Wang Shuo took out the prepared "Thought Stamp" scroll and threw it to Mira.

"Sign this first!"

Although Mira had no hands and a row of short legs, she used special energy to unfold the scroll.

"What is this? I don't know the words on it!" Mira said puzzled.

Wang Shuo almost spit out a mouthful of blood. You are a golden boss, but you don't know the current common characters.

You are kidding!

Fortunately, Wang Shuo has learned a lot of characters from the North Sea Empire era.

Rewrite all the characters above in the characters of the North Sea Empire period.

"Master, don't you believe me?"

"Of course." Wang Shuo said affirmatively.

Mira rolled her eyes. This time, there was finally no way to fool her.

She had originally just wanted to give it a try. If she could use the enslavement scroll to take this human as her pet, she would be able to turn the tables.

Now she had no choice but to accept her fate. If she resisted again, Wang Shuo would only end up dead, given his cautious character.

She signed the "Thought Seal" scroll with frustration.

Mira's loyalty suddenly became 100%.

At this time, she slightly adjusted a few symbols in the contract just now, and Wang Shuo walked in with a smile.

In the treaty just signed, there was a clause that Wang Shuo should not be harmed.

[Zerg Golden Boss Mira has become your pet through the contract. ]

After the system prompt sounded, Wang Shuo was completely relieved.

"Master, I have a gift for you." Mira's voice had become very respectful.

A scroll floated in front of Wang Shuo.

[Multiplication: After casting, you can increase your breath and body size. The real strength does not change, 60 points of mental power are consumed per minute, the size is related to the skill level, and the breath can only be increased by one level. 】

Wang Shuo then understood why she had grown several times in size just now, it turned out to be a skill.

When I checked it just now, it was not displayed, which made Wang Shuo more cautious.

It seems that some bosses' skills cannot be viewed in full.

Wang Shuo immediately clicked to learn.

At this time, the system prompt sounded again.

[You have completed the exploration of the ancient battlefield and controlled the entire area of the ancient battlefield No. 27. From now on, you can set some rules in the copy. 】
